title: Scrub It Out! Erasing Sensitive Memorization in Code Language Models via Machine Unlearning
core_idea: Split sensitive segments from benign context and apply opposite-direction gradient updates with a KL constraint
metrics: Memorization Accuracy (MA); Extraction Likelihood (EL); Pass@1; Pass@5; Pass@10; Utility retention; GPU time; Peak GPU memory
metrics_display: Memorization accuracy; Extraction likelihood; Pass@k; Utility retention; GPU time; Peak memory

title: Large Language Model Unlearning for Source Code
target: Copyrighted code / unsafe code / deprecated API
core_idea: Zero out forget-token probabilities then proportionally redistribute the remaining mass and fit that target distribution
metrics: Forget quality; 1-BLEU; Static-analysis pass rate; Exact Match; HumanEval functional correctness; Model utility; Pareto Dominance Ratio (PDR)
metrics_display: Forget quality; 1-BLEU; API exact match; Model utility; Pareto dominance ratio

title: Mitigating Sensitive Information Leakage in LLMs4Code through Machine Unlearning
core_idea: Systematic comparison of gradient-ascent and regularization-based unlearning; observes direct-to-indirect leakage shift
base_models: AIXCoder-7B; CodeLlama-7B; CodeLlama-13B; CodeLlama-34B; CodeQwen-1.5B; CodeQwen-3B; CodeQwen-7B; CodeQwen-14B
metrics: Leak Rate; Direct Privacy Leakage Ratio; Indirect Privacy Leakage Ratio; Pass@1; Utility retention
edited_models: AIXCoder-7B; CodeLlama-7B; CodeLlama-13B; CodeLlama-34B; CodeQwen-1.5B; CodeQwen-3B; CodeQwen-7B; CodeQwen-14B
metrics_display: Direct leak rate; Indirect leak rate; Pass@1

title: Towards Knowledge Alignment in Code LLMs: Contrastive Unlearning for Evolving APIs
core_idea: Adds a contrastive loss so the model prefers the replacement API sequence over the deprecated one in the same context
metrics: Deprecated API Usage Rate; Replacement API Usage Rate; Mismatch API Usage Rate; HumanEval Pass@1; Pass@3; Pass@5; Utility retention
metrics_display: Deprecated API rate; Replacement API rate; Mismatch API rate; Pass@k

title: When Forgetting Builds Reliability: LLM Unlearning for Reliable Hardware Code Generation
target: Designated RTL training samples simulating proprietary, contaminated, or unsafe content
core_idea: Syntax-preserving token masks exclude keyword positions from the forgetting loss; shared parameters remain trainable and a floor-aware selective loss stabilizes forgetting
metrics: PrivLeak; MinK++; Cross-entropy loss; Pass@1; BLEU; chrF; HumanEval Pass@1; HumanEval Pass@5; MBPP Pass@1; MBPP Pass@5; Utility retention
metrics_display: PrivLeak; MinK++; Cross-entropy; Pass@k; BLEU; chrF

title: SALAD: Systematic Assessment of Machine Unlearning on LLM-Aided Hardware Design
target: Contaminated benchmarks / IP leakage / malicious Verilog
core_idea: Applies GA/GD/PO/NPO/RMU/SimNPO to forget contaminated VerilogEval/RTLLM data, custom designs, and proprietary IP from a fine-tuned Llama 3.1-8B while measuring Pass@k on holdout RTL generation
baselines: GA; GD; PO; NPO; RMU; SimNPO
metrics: Forget ROUGE (ROUGE-L recall); Min-K%; Min-K%++; CDD; Pass@1; Pass@5; Pass@10; Pass@15; Utility retention; Forget Probability (normalized answer probability); PrivLeak (membership-inference AUC difference)
benchmark: VerilogEval; RTLLM; RTL-Repo; in-house IP; poisoned RTL designs; RTLCoder retain set

title: Unlearning Trojans in Large Language Models: A Comparison Between Natural Language and Source Code
core_idea: Gradient ascent combined with EWC Fisher regularization and early stopping

title: Backdoor Token Unlearning: Exposing and Defending Backdoors in Pretrained Language Models
core_idea: Detects tokens whose embedding parameters shift abnormally then unlearns only the over-shifted embedding dimensions
baselines: BKI; MF; CUBE; TG; ST; DPOE; ONION; RAP; Strip

title: DUP: Detection-guided Unlearning for Backdoor Purification in Language Models
core_idea: Mahalanobis and spectral anomaly detection guides LoRA teacher-student self-distillation that maximizes divergence on poisoned samples
baselines: STRIP; DAN; NAS; ONION; BadActs; TG
metrics: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC); False Acceptance Rate (FAR); False Rejection Rate (FRR); Clean Accuracy; Attack Success Rate (ASR)
metrics_display: ROC AUC; False acceptance rate; False rejection rate; Clean accuracy; Attack success rate

title: Backdoor Unlearning Generalization: A Path Toward the Removal of Unknown Triggers in LLMs
core_idea: Shows that unlearning one trigger via continual pretraining can suppress other never-targeted backdoors and introduces CASD to explain cross-backdoor transfer
metrics: Attack Success Rate (ASR); Cross Activation Shift Distance (CASD); Accuracy on HellaSwag, ARC-Easy and MMLU; General model utility
edited_models: Qwen3-1.7B; Qwen3-8B; Llama-3.2-1B; Llama-3.1-8B; Gaperon-1B; Gaperon-8B
metrics_display: Attack success rate; Cross activation shift distance; Retained-task accuracy

title: LLM Ghostbusters: Surgical Hallucination Suppression via Adaptive Unlearning
core_idea: Hybrid token-level CE+NPO objective with an adaptive discovery loop that suppresses hallucinated package names without a pre-specified forget set
metrics: Package hallucination rate; Pass@1; Retained coding utility; KL divergence (code, instruction and package outputs); Actual used training checkpoints; Consumed wall-clock run budget
metrics_display: Package hallucination rate; Pass@1; KL divergence; Used checkpoints; Run time
